adjudication.rationale: In `packages/core/EventManager.ts`, `updateAllCalendarEvents` was changed to handle multiple calendar references: `calendarReference` is now an array and iterated via `for (const reference of calendarReference)`. Inside that loop, when `reference.credentialId` is present and not found in `this.calendarCredentials`, the code performs `await prisma.credential.findUnique({ where: { id: reference.credentialId } ... })` (sequentially per reference). This is a classic N+1/per-reference lookup pattern that can be batched (e.g., pre-collect credentialIds and `findMany`). It’s a performance/architecture concern introduced by the diff, not an immediate correctness bug.
